summary.text: Anne Ferrell Tata is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates for District 99, representing part of the city of Virginia Beach, serving since 2022. The House's member profile lists committee assignments including Education and Counties, Cities and Towns.

paragraphs.text: Anne Ferrell H. Tata was born in Washington, D.C., according to the House's member profile.
The profile says she earned a B.S. in communications from Florida State University and lists her occupation as Christian media.
The profile lists her memberships as the iFoster board and the National Society of Colonial Dames of America.
